# PlatformConsole

<!-- generated by .kb/generate.mjs — do not edit by hand -->

**Layer:** api + web  
**Status:** partial

## Purpose

What the platform operator sees. Demo-request pipeline, provisioning, and eventually impersonation.

## Features

- Demo-request list with status pipeline
- Provision an organization from a demo request or from scratch
- Platform admin login, separate from any tenant

## User actions

- Review incoming demo requests
- Provision a clinic
- Sign in to the platform console at the `admin.` subdomain

## Business rules

- [BR-PLT-001](../BusinessRules/PlatformConsole.md#br-plt-001)
- [BR-PLT-002](../BusinessRules/PlatformConsole.md#br-plt-002)

## Workspace dependencies

`@rcln/billing` · `@rcln/contracts` · `@rcln/db` · `@rcln/db/unsafe` · `@rcln/permissions`

## Known limitations

- Impersonation is not implemented. The session it mints must carry a real branch scope — a platform admin has no membership, so `loadUserAccess` returns null and every branch-scoped write would be refused
- No plan or subscription management screens
